commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C
TARGET="4f5c261301b865ea4af1bbb8d274c7dbd469d707"
PKG="pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge"
EXPECTED_CERT="fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11"
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
command -v gh >/dev/null
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1
if gh release view v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "RELEASE_TAG_EXISTS_REFUSED=true"; exit 40; fi
git fetch --no-tags origin main
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" = "$TARGET"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-mvp022-source-XXXXXX)"
OUT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-mvp022-artifact-XXXXXX)"
BACKUP="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-mvp022-rollback-XXXXXX)"
SERIAL=""
INSTALLED_NEW=0
BACKED_UP=0
ROLLED_BACK=0
phone_idle() {
  [[ -n "$SERIAL" ]] || return 1
  local state mode
  state="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1 | tr -d '\r' || true)"
  mode="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1 | tr -d '\r' || true)"
  [[ "$state" == 0 && "$mode" == MODE_NORMAL ]]
}
cleanup() {
  local code="$?"
  trap - EXIT
  if [[ "$code" != 0 && "$INSTALLED_NEW" == 1 && "$BACKED_UP" == 1 ]]; then
    if phone_idle; then
      echo "ROLLBACK_ATTEMPT=true"
      if adb -s "$SERIAL" install --no-streaming -r -d "$BACKUP/previous.apk" >/dev/null; then
        ROLLED_BACK=1
        echo "PREVIOUS_APP_ROLLBACK_PASS=true"
      else
        echo "PREVIOUS_APP_ROLLBACK_FAILED=true"
      fi
    else
      echo "ROLLBACK_HOLD_PHONE_NOT_IDLE=true"
    fi
  fi
  cd "$ROOT"
  git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  rm -rf "$OUT"
  if [[ "$code" == 0 || "$INSTALLED_NEW" == 0 || "$ROLLED_BACK" == 1 ]]; then
    rm -rf "$BACKUP"
  else
    echo "ROLLBACK_APK_RETAINED=$BACKUP"
  fi
  exit "$code"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "$TARGET"
cd "$WORK"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$TARGET"
grep -q 'versionName = "0.2.2"' app/build.gradle.kts
grep -q 'versionCode = 4' app/build.gradle.kts
echo "FINAL_SOURCE_SHA=$TARGET"
echo "STAGE=RELEASE_BUILD"
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
if [[ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" && -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; fi
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
UNSIGNED="app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk"
test -s "$UNSIGNED"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1)"
test -x "$SIGNER"
ZIPALIGN="$(dirname "$SIGNER")/zipalign"
test -x "$ZIPALIGN"
"$ZIPALIGN" -f -p 4 "$UNSIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk" >/dev/null
echo "STAGE=SIGN_EXACT_PREVIOUS_CERT"
APK="$OUT/ai-calls-v0.2.2.apk"
"$SIGNER" sign --ks "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" --ks-key-alias androiddebugkey --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --out "$APK" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
"$SIGNER" verify "$APK"
ACTUAL_CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$ACTUAL_CERT" = "$EXPECTED_CERT" || { echo "SIGNER_MISMATCH_REFUSED=true"; exit 41; }
test -s "$APK"
printf 'FINAL_APK_BYTES=%s\n' "$(stat -f%z "$APK")"
cd "$OUT"
shasum -a 256 ai-calls-v0.2.2.apk > SHA256SUMS.txt
cat > RELEASE_NOTES.txt <<EOF
AI Calls 0.2.2 — MVP preview (not production qualified).

Final source: 4f5c261301b865ea4af1bbb8d274c7dbd469d707.
Consolidates verified FE/presentation/domain/data extraction; UI, navigation and data unchanged.
Removes old screenshot assets and stale working docs.
Previously verified: Polish incoming GSM, encrypted notes and WAV.
English live GSM and outgoing GSM for this APK remain unverified.
No real GSM calls were performed in finalization.
EOF
cd "$WORK"
echo "STAGE=VERIFY_PHONE_IDLE"
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery)"
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state)" = device
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')" = SM-S906B
test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.release | tr -d '\r')" = 16
phone_idle || { echo "PHONE_NOT_IDLE_REFUSED=true"; exit 42; }
echo "STAGE=BACKUP_EXISTING_PRODUCTION_APP"
PTH="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
if [[ -n "$PTH" ]]; then
  test "$(printf '%s\n' "$PTH" | grep -c '^package:')" = 1 || { echo "PACKAGE_SPLITS_UNSUPPORTED=true"; exit 43; }
  REMOTE="$(printf '%s\n' "$PTH" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
  adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$REMOTE" "$BACKUP/previous.apk" >/dev/null
  test -s "$BACKUP/previous.apk"
  PREVIOUS_CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$BACKUP/previous.apk" 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
  test "$PREVIOUS_CERT" = "$EXPECTED_CERT" || { echo "INSTALLED_SIGNER_MISMATCH_REFUSED=true"; exit 44; }
  BACKED_UP=1
  echo "PREVIOUS_PRODUCTION_APK_BACKUP_PASS=true"
else
  echo "PRODUCTION_APP_NOT_PREVIOUSLY_INSTALLED=true"
fi
phone_idle || { echo "PHONE_IDLE_CHANGED_REFUSED=true"; exit 45; }
echo "STAGE=INSTALL_FINAL_APK"
adb -s "$SERIAL" install --no-streaming -r "$APK"
INSTALLED_NEW=1
phone_idle || { echo "POST_INSTALL_NOT_IDLE=true"; exit 46; }
echo "STAGE=VERIFY_EXACT_INSTALLED_APK"
PTH="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$PTH" | grep -c '^package:')" = 1
REMOTE="$(printf '%s\n' "$PTH" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$REMOTE" "$BACKUP/installed.apk" >/dev/null
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$BACKUP/installed.apk" | awk '{print $1}')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG" | grep -q 'versionName=0.2.2'
echo "FINAL_PRODUCTION_APK_INSTALLED_SHA256_MATCH=true"
echo "STAGE=VERIFY_EXISTING_S8_HOST_UNCHANGED"
export ANDROID_SERIAL="$SERIAL"
bash scripts/bin/start-s8-gsm-shell.sh --start
STATUS="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell content call --uri content://pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab.gsmbinder --method status 2>/dev/null || true)"
[[ "$STATUS" == *host_registered=true* ]] || { echo "S8_HOST_NOT_READY=true"; exit 47; }
phone_idle || { echo "POSTFLIGHT_NOT_IDLE=true"; exit 48; }
echo "S22_FINAL_INSTALL_PASS=true NO_GSM_CALLS=true USER_DATA_PRESERVED=true"
echo "STAGE=CREATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE"
gh release create v0.2.2 "$OUT/ai-calls-v0.2.2.apk" "$OUT/SHA256SUMS.txt" -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --target "$TARGET" --title "AI Calls 0.2.2 — MVP preview" --notes-file "$OUT/RELEASE_NOTES.txt" --prerelease
gh release view v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' | grep -Fxq 'ai-calls-v0.2.2.apk'
gh release view v0.2.2 -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' | grep -Fxq 'SHA256SUMS.txt'
phone_idle || { echo "POST_RELEASE_NOT_IDLE=true"; exit 49; }
INSTALLED_NEW=0
echo "MVP_0_2_2_FINAL_RELEASE_PASS=true"
echo "RELEASE_URL=https://github.com/MichalMatu/ai-calls/releases/tag/v0.2.2"
echo "APK_URL=https://github.com/MichalMatu/ai-calls/releases/download/v0.2.2/ai-calls-v0.2.2.apk"
echo "FINAL_SHA=$TARGET"
echo "REAL_GSM_CALLS=false"
